steps.thought: I will list all available station tests to understand the test suite and choose the most cost-effective initial checks.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check I2C, UART, and CAN bus enumeration as a cheap initial check across major subsystems.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully, enumerating all expected CAN nodes, UART devices, camera sensor, I2C IMU, and compass. This indicates basic system boot and bus communication are operational.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power-on selftest passed, but all other subsystems must be tested before confirming a healthy unit.
Motor subsystem not yet tested; cannot rule out mechanical wear.
ESC telemetry not yet run.
Battery tests not yet performed.
IMU static test not yet performed to check sensor noise and bias.

steps.thought: I will run battery_rest_check next as a cheap check on the battery subsystem to ensure per-cell voltages and rest state are nominal.
steps.observation: The battery_rest_check passed successfully, showing normal pack voltage, healthy per-cell voltages, and low cell imbalance, ruling out basic battery rest defects.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial power-on selftest and battery rest check passed successfully, but all remaining subsystems must be tested.
Motors have not yet been spun up to check for mechanical wear or imbalance.
ESC telemetry test has not been executed yet.
IMU static test has not been run to verify sensor bias and noise.
Camera selftest has not been run yet to verify CSI and frame rate.

steps.thought: Run esc_telemetry to check ESC sync, packet loss, and back-EMF detection.
steps.observation: The esc_telemetry test passed successfully with zero sync errors, normal temperatures, and very low packet loss across all four ESCs.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on selftest, battery rest check, and ESC telemetry all passed with no failures or anomalies.
Motors and propellers have not yet been tested under load or spin conditions.
IMU static test has not been run yet to check detailed noise and bias metrics.
Camera selftest has not been run yet to verify CSI link and frame rates.
Compass static and motor interference tests have not yet been executed.

steps.thought: I will run the compass_static test to verify compass heading alignment before motor-on tests.
steps.observation: The compass_static test passed with a minor heading error of -0.73 degrees and normal field magnitude, ruling out static compass offset issues. Subsystems checked so far (system, battery, esc, compass) are all healthy.

hypotheses.rationale: All tests run so far (power_on_selftest, battery_rest_check, esc_telemetry, compass_static) have passed without any failures or anomalies.
Motor spin test has not yet been executed to check for vibration or RPM jitter under load.
IMU static test has not yet been run to evaluate detailed gyro and accelerometer noise characteristics.
Camera selftest has not been run yet to verify CSI framing and sensor stability.

steps.thought: Run the motor_spin_test to check for motor bearing degradation, RPM jitter, or imbalance since motor and propulsion subsystems have not yet been tested under load.
steps.observation: The motor_spin_test passed successfully across all four motors with normal RPM, currents, and jitter. Subsystems remaining to check are harness, camera, IMU, and battery load.

hypotheses.rationale: System, battery, ESC, compass, and motor subsystems have all passed their initial evaluations cleanly without failures.
IMU static test has not yet been executed to verify gyro/accel noise and bias stability.
Camera self-test has not been executed to verify CSI frame stability and absence of dropped frames.
Battery load test has not yet been performed to measure internal resistance and high-draw voltage sag.

steps.thought: Run imu_static to check gyro bias, accelerometer noise, and dropouts, covering the IMU subsystem which hasn't been tested yet.
steps.observation: The imu_static test failed with 32 out of 1000 samples dropped, pointing directly to an IMU sensor communication or processing fault.

hypotheses.rationale: The imu_static test explicitly failed due to a high rate of dropped samples (32 dropped out of 1000).
Dropped samples on the I2C IMU sensor could alternatively be caused by an intermittent connection on the I2C bus harness.

steps.thought: I will run the harness continuity test to rule out an I2C connection issue before replacing the IMU daughterboard.
steps.observation: The harness_continuity test passed with perfect continuity and normal resistance across I2C, UART, and CAN, ruling out bus wiring issues such as a loose I2C connector. Combined with the previous imu_static failure showing 32 dropped samples, this points conclusively to an internal IMU sensor hardware fault.

hypotheses.rationale: High dropped sample count during imu_static while harness continuity and bus resistance remain completely normal.
Small possibility of mechanical decoupling causing vibration or sample timing issues, though less likely than internal sensor failure.

steps.thought: The imu_static test failed with 32 dropped samples and harness_continuity passed, pointing directly to an IMU sensor fault. I am ready to propose the final rework action.
steps.observation: Rework applied; full suite passed: True.
